zh.caption: 圖 1｜原本的收件流程
zh.description: 四個步驟依序進行；「顯示成功」尚未說明成功的範圍。

zh.caption: 圖 2｜從 HCI、UI、UX 檢查收件系統
zh.description: 三種觀點互相影響，並列呈現，不表示先後階段。

items.title: HCI：研究為什麼會誤解
items.body:
使用者心目中的「成功」是什麼意思？他是否知道欄位齊全和正式受理不同？

可以請他直接說明畫面意思，而不是由開發者自行猜測。

items.title: UI：修改畫面上呈現的資訊
items.body:
不要只顯示「成功」，而要說明具體完成了什麼。

例如：「三個必要欄位已齊全，尚未正式送件。」

同時提供清楚的下一步操作。

items.title: UX：確認整段工作是否順利
items.body:
即使畫面讓人看懂了，承辦人匯出報告後，究竟應該交給誰？接手者能不能使用？

如果接手者還得重新輸入全部資料，整體工作流程仍然有問題。

zh.caption: 圖 3｜狀態提示的修改前與候選修改
zh.description: 示意畫面，不是真實系統或測試結果；候選修改仍需要驗證。

items.title: 修改前
items.body:
成功！

操作完成

確定

沒有解釋成功的是什麼，也不知道下一步。

items.title: 候選修改
items.body:
欄位檢查完成

3 個必要欄位已齊全。

尚未正式受理，請依程序辦理送件。

匯出檢查報告

明確說明狀態，以及接下來能做什麼。

en.caption: Figure 1 | The original intake process
en.description: Four steps proceed in order; “Success” does not specify what has succeeded.

en.caption: Figure 2 | Examine intake through HCI, UI and UX
en.description: The perspectives influence one another and are presented in parallel, not as successive phases.

items.title: HCI: investigate the misunderstanding
items.body:
What does “success” mean to the user? Do they know that complete fields and official acceptance differ?

Ask them to explain the screen directly rather than having developers guess.

items.title: UI: change the information on screen
items.body:
Explain specifically what has been completed instead of only showing “Success.”

For example: “Three required fields are complete; the case has not been formally submitted.”

Provide a clear next action.

items.title: UX: check whether the whole task works
items.body:
Even if the screen is understandable, who should receive the exported report? Can the next worker use it?

If that worker must re-enter all the information, the overall workflow still has a problem.

en.caption: Figure 3 | Status feedback before and after a candidate change
en.description: Illustrative screens, not an actual system or test results; the candidate still needs testing.

items.title: Before
items.body:
Success!

Operation completed

OK

It does not explain what succeeded or what to do next.

items.title: Candidate change
items.body:
Field check completed

3 required fields are complete.

Not officially accepted yet; follow the submission procedure.

Export check report

It states the status and the available next action.
